column_hoeffding.method: Hoeffding, independent per-page column scores in [0,k_p]
column_hoeffding.caveat: An upper bound under the slot model, not an exact p-value; no correction for exploratory selection is supplied.

column.interpretation: Tail under the supplied simulation model; no extreme-tail extrapolation. Plus-one is an MC reporting convention, not proof of exchangeability.
